nodes.label: DR-07.1 (gate is deterministic, no LLM)
nodes.rationale: The gate scores candidates M×R×N deterministically; the model only writes the brief after the gate decides.

nodes.label: A-6 (R=0 hard exclusion)
nodes.rationale: R=0 (unmapped reach) excludes a candidate before scoring, not as a floor, so unmapped entities never earn a brief.

nodes.label: Seed org-anchors waste track budget (data-quality fix)

nodes.label: promo_30d cold-start artifact finding
nodes.rationale: First-ever ladder run stamped clustered maturity promotions as 'recent', tripping the raw_tier breakout condition even with P=0.0 star velocity; legitimate per the state machine but weak, and it washes out as promotions age past 30 days — not a bug to fix.

nodes.label: DR-08.2 (draft → review → publish)
nodes.rationale: Briefs require human review before publish; nothing auto-publishes.

nodes.label: DR-09.1 (Changes view deterministic, no LLM)
nodes.rationale: Every Changes row is a fixed-template sentence over computed diffs; a future weekly-narrative model would be a new registered checkpoint, not an exception.

nodes.label: DR-09.2 (scoring is a human ritual, advisory auto-eval)
nodes.rationale: Auto-eval never writes a score itself; record_score is always an explicit operator action.
nodes.norm_label: dr-09.2 (scoring is a human ritual, advisory auto-eval)

nodes.label: idea-spec §7 (one-sided brief is marketing)
nodes.rationale: Warns against a counter_mechanism that is a bare taxonomy keyword instead of a genuine argument; a brief without a real counter is not publishable.

nodes.label: DR-11.2 (structured assertions, not a prose DSL)
nodes.rationale: Parsing free-form assertion expressions would be fragile, so expect became typed fields reading structured pipeline output, never prose.
nodes.norm_label: dr-11.2 (structured assertions, not a prose dsl)

nodes.label: DR-11.1 (no separate backtest engine)
nodes.rationale: The hindcast runner drives the real orchestrators (resolve/snapshot/score/gate/comprehend/brief) rather than a bespoke backtest engine.

nodes.label: H3a reframed to mode: never
nodes.rationale: Attention (HN) is excluded from the velocity composite by design (idea-spec principle 3); a pure attention spike must never climb to accelerating/breakout, so H3a asserts that guarantee directly rather than asserting 'reached simmering'.

nodes.label: seismograph_hindcast isolated DB recipe
nodes.rationale: A hindcast must run against an isolated, clean DB — running against the live dev DB caused an entity_merges loser_id PK collision because past as-of resolve tried to redo a future-dated merge.
